Subject: Micron pilot KPI recap + quick endorsement request

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for partnering with us on the three-week pilot. We appreciated the fast feedback loop from your team. Attached is a short KPI summary (micron_pilot_kpis_2027-07-19.xlsx) plus a one-page snapshot I pulled together. High-level results:

- Inference latency (p95) improved from ~230ms to ~72ms with Redwood Dedicated routing
- Model cost per 1k tokens down ~48% vs baseline after batching/quantization changes
- End-to-end CPU time for your pre/post-processing pipeline reduced 21% due to our edge cache suggestion
- Conversational throughput during peak test increased from 55 reqs/s to 145 reqs/s under the reserved pool

We'd love to include Micron Analytics as a short reference and, if you're open, a 30-second quote we can use in a case snippet. Minimal asks:

1) One sentence (1–2 lines) saying what outcome you saw and why that matters for Micron.
2) Optional 15–30 minute call next week if you prefer to chat through wording.

If it's helpful, Marissa can draft a couple of 1–2 line options for you to pick from.

Thanks — appreciate the partnership.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
